slot_scores.name: robot_doll_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether manufacturing robots prevents making dolls or otherwise inquire about restrictions between robots and dolls before READY_TO_MODEL.

slot_scores.name: doll_model_car_quantity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether doll production is capped by the number of model cars or mention the dolls versus model cars quantity relationship before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Robots and dolls can be manufactured simultaneously; there is no mutual-exclusion constraint between them.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the robot-doll business rule, and the final READY_TO_MODEL model includes no constraint preventing simultaneous robot and doll production.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Doll production is not capped by or linked to model car production.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a dolls-versus-model-cars quantity limit, and the final READY_TO_MODEL model contains no such linking constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 hidden business constraints remained unasked and unconfirmed, so the stop was premature.

summary: The agent clarified the model-car/building-block implication and variable-domain issues, but missed the two P1 business constraints on robot-doll mutual exclusion and doll production versus model car production, then declared all critical facts confirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
